name: dev.ioconnex/price-tracker-mcp
title: price-tracker-mcp
description: Product price checks and affiliate link building for AI shopping agents.

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: Check the current price of a product page.

url.description: The http(s) product page URL. Private/loopback hosts are rejected.

tools.name: find_best_price
tools.description:
Find the best price for one product across reputable stores.

Provide ONE of: a product query ("Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 256GB"), a
product page URL (identity is read from the page), or a UPC / GTIN / EAN.
Returns a ranked offer list with evidence per offer. ``best_offer`` is
set only when the winner is a high-confidence product match with a known
delivered total; otherwise ``verdict`` explains the abstention
(``best_found_total_unverified`` or ``no_confident_match``).

url.description: Product page URL (http(s); private/loopback hosts rejected).

condition.description:
'new' (default), 'used', 'refurbished', or 'any'. Used and
refurbished offers never mix into the new-price ranking.

country.description: Market to search (default 'US'; Tier A sources are US APIs).

path.description:
Customer's choice (broker layer): 'direct' (default) returns
plain retailer links and IOConnex earns only the lookup fee;
'broker' affiliate-tags the winning offer's link when IOConnex
is enrolled in that retailer's program, disclosed in
``take_disclosure``. Ranking and prices are identical either
way, and the lookup costs the same in both paths.

tools.name: make_affiliate_link
tools.description: Build an affiliate tracking link for a product URL.

program.description: 'amazon' (sets the tag parameter) or a custom query parameter name.
